content.doc_md:
ISO 8601is theInternational Standardfor representingdatesandtimes.

It is a machine-readable text format in the formYYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

ISO 8601 was designed to eliminate confusion caused by regional date variations.

It follows a "largest to smallest" hierarchy (year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
which ensures that dates are alphabetically sortable.

AnISO 8601 stringrepresents dates and times in a structured and sortable format:

AnISO 8601 durationrepresent lengths of time.

It uses a standard format starting with±P(Period),
followed by the structurenYnMnDTnHnMnS.

RFC 3339is theInternet Standardfor Date and Time Formats.

It is aSubset of ISO 8601designed for use in Internet protocols.

RFC 9557is the primary format used byJavaScript Temporalto represent dates.

RFC 5545is the official internet standard for theiCalendardata format.
It defines how calendar systems should store and share calendar data like meetings, tasks,
and free/busy times using plain text files.

iCalendar istext-based. It Uses readable lines of text encoded inUTF-8.

iCalendar is isapplication independent. It works across different apps like Apple Calendar,
Google Calendar, and Microsoft Outlook.

A calendar system defines how dates are calculated.

Different cultures use different calendars.

Based on the Earth's orbit around the sun.

These calendars track seasons accurately.

Based on the phases of the moon.

Lunar calendars have shorter years.

Combine solar and lunar cycles.

They adjust months to stay aligned with seasons.

Use eras instead of a continuous year count.

Thefrom()method supports calendars using the [u-ca=calendar] syntax or a calendar
property in objects.
